EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 514 December 19, 1978
PRESCRIBING NEW SALARY RATES FOR THE CHAIRMAN AND MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL
POLICE COMMISSION
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby order and direct that effective January 1, 1978, the following rates of salary shall apply to the
Chairman and Members of the National Police Commission:
Chairman CESO II, Grade III
Member CESO III, Grade III
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
